3. Switch mechanism: The switch mechanism is the part of the temperature switch that converts the movement of the sensing element into an electrical signal. It can be a mechanical or electronic switch.
4. Wiring: The wiring connects the temperature switch to the control system, and provides the electrical signal to the control system.
5. Control system: The control system is the part of the temperature switch that uses the electrical signal from the sensing element to take appropriate action, such as opening or closing a circuit, to maintain the desired temperature.
